page.layout: One page of text, centred dedication block. No running head, page number, catchword or signature. Show-through, library stamp and handwritten notes are left out.

main_text.l: Dn. Henrico Leuchtero, Sacrosanctæ Theologiæ Doctori, & superioris Hassiæ Visitatori dignissimo:

l.i: Dn. M. Joanni Bangio, verbi divini apud Rengershausenses præconi vigilantissimo:
Dn. Joanni Grimmæo, verbi divini ministro apud Eilhausenses fidelissimo, cognato & susceptori suo reverenter colendo:

main_text.l: Dn. Severino Riemenschneidero, apud Allendorffenses ad Lumbdam pastori & Cognato suo suavissimo:

l.i: Dominis patronis ac Mecœnatibus suis perpetua observantia colendis:

main_text.l: Gratitudinis ergò has studiorum suorum primitias inscribit, offert & dedicat

page.notes: Faint mirrored text in the upper centre (possibly "THEMATA PHYSICA") and faint text from the reverse of the leaf below the dedication are show-through and were not transcribed. The "Dn." abbreviations and the "M." are set in italic and are read with some doubt. The line "Dominis patronis ac Mecœnatibus" is treated as its own paragraph because it is set in italic on a new line. A library stamp "BSB MÜNCHEN", a handwritten "Astr. p. 206" and a shelf mark "VW/90/94" are not printed text and were left out.
